mentions.name: SecurityBot.dev
mentions.description: An all-in-one monitoring tool for websites that combines uptime, performance, security, and SEO checks. Features include standard uptime monitoring, a PageSpeed Insights monitor, and a broken link checker, with new monitor types added over time based on the builder's own needs and user feedback. It has been running since its launch a few months ago and recently approached its 1 millionth uptime check.
mentions.source_excerpt: SecurityBot.dev is an all-in-one uptime, performance, security, and SEO monitoring tool. I launched it a few months ago and have been iterating on it ever since.

mentions.name: SecurityBot
mentions.description: A service that combines uptime, performance, SEO, and security monitoring for websites. It includes PageSpeed Insights analysis, a broken link auditor (401, 404, 500, etc.), and historical ping/uptime results. It also ships an MCP server that delivers broken link results to Cursor so they can be rapidly resolved.
